title: mycmp
summary: cmp(1): the first byte where two files differ, or which one ends first.
hints: Read both files with `fgetc` at the same time and count the bytes and the `'\n'` seen so far in the first file. Stop at the first difference.
Exit status: 0 identical, 1 different, 2 for trouble (usage, a file that cannot be opened). Use `fopen(name, "rb")` (binary-safe, `fgetc` returns `int` so a 0 byte is not the end).
